text_en: Jin Shi Data August 14 - Regarding the market-concerned issue of idle funds circulating within the financial system, industry experts said that M2 and total social financing are two different statistical indicators with differences in statistical calibers. It is normal for one to grow faster than the other, and there is no clear policy implication. Whether funds are idle in the banking system cannot be judged by comparing M2 growth with social financing growth. In addition, regarding deposit growth versus loan growth, experts said that in the context of diversified financing structures, deposit growth outpacing loan growth is a normal phenomenon. In earlier years, loan issuance was the main channel for deposit creation, and deposit and loan growth rates were relatively close. In recent years, with the development of financial markets, the loan channel has been increasingly replaced by other creation channels such as bonds in the process of deposit creation.
